issues.title: Changing intervalMs no longer restarts polling
issues.explanation: With an empty dependency array the effect runs once, so a new intervalMs is ignored for the life of the component. FE-212 requires a restart.

issues.title: Polls with the first render's fetcher forever
issues.explanation: run closes over the fetcher from the first render. When filter changes, the widget keeps polling the old query. Dropping fetcher from deps fixed the restart-every-render problem the wrong way.
issues.fix: Keep the latest fetcher in a ref updated each render and call fetcherRef.current() inside run.

issues.title: Cleanup no longer sets cancelled
issues.explanation: cancelled is never set to true, so a response that lands after unmount still calls setData. The guard on line 13 is now dead code.

issues.title: Error path lost its cancelled guard
issues.explanation: setError now runs even after unmount, unlike the success path.
